alerts.label: Dashboard unreachable
alerts.action: Watchdog auto-restarts. WhatsApp alert if still down after restart.

alerts.label: n8n unreachable
alerts.description: Port 5678 not responding — new calls cannot enter the pipeline
alerts.action: Watchdog auto-restarts. WhatsApp alert if still down after restart.

alerts.label: Dead-letter queue growing
alerts.description: Files in queue/deadletter/ — calls failed to process
alerts.action: Daily brief includes count. Manual replay required (no auto-replay in Phase 1).

alerts.label: Unacknowledged red-flag case
alerts.description: A 999 Emergency case has been on the dashboard for more than 10 minutes without staff action
alerts.check: dashboard alert_events table: priority=999 Emergency, status=New, age > 10 min
alerts.action: Dashboard shows prominent warning. Evening brief flags it.

alerts.label: Ollama response slow
alerts.description: LLM extraction taking longer than 60 seconds per call
alerts.action: Log warning. Check Ollama resource usage. Note in daily brief.

alerts.label: Database file large
alerts.action: Run GDPR purge (90-day). Note in weekly report.
